title: Musset guide: how to write, revise and publish a book on the Mac
description: The manual for Musset, the Mac writing app: tutorials, how-tos and reference for drafting, structuring, revising, sharing and publishing a book.
lede: How to do each thing in Musset, from the first sentence to the file a publisher or a printer expects. Tutorials to follow once, how-tos to come back to, and a reference for the rest.
